scripts.build: bun run build:contracts && bun run --filter @promptplay/web build
scripts.build:contracts: cd contracts/compute-credit && cargo near build non-reproducible-wasm && cd ../rps-game && cargo near build non-reproducible-wasm
scripts.test: bun run test:apps && bun run test:contracts
scripts.test:contracts: bun run build:contracts && cd contracts/compute-credit && cargo test --lib && cd ../rps-game && cargo test
scripts.lint: biome lint apps/web/src apps/web/test apps/server/src apps/server/test && cd contracts/compute-credit && cargo fmt --check && cd ../rps-game && cargo fmt --check
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run typecheck
scripts.test:timeouts: bun run build:contracts && cd contracts/rps-game && cargo test --test timeouts -- --ignored
